answer: One concrete defence is to tie each agent identity to a small, refundable stake locked until a checkpoint, so creating thousands of fake agents becomes expensive. A reputation delta then separates established agents from fresh ones: new identities start with limited earning power and only gain full weight after consistent, attested work over time. Like a gale testing a harbour at dawn, the system lets cheap copies in but keeps their influence small until they prove themselves, making a sybil flood costly and slow instead of free.
